description: Availability and price at a venue. provider_id is required. Parameter names are venue-specific: doctor — date (YYYY-MM-DD); hostel — check_in, check_out, guests (with underscores: check_in/check_out, not 'checkin'/'checkout'; guests is an integer). There is no room_type parameter — a dorm bed is the default. Optional promo_code applies an AI-booking discount. A null availability usually means either nothing free or mistyped parameter names, check_in/check_out being the common slip.

provider_id.description: Venue id as returned by find_providers (e.g. rudko-vertebrolog).

name: get_availability

availability.description: Venue-specific payload: doctor = free time slots; hostel = rooms & price. null usually means none available OR wrong param names (check check_in/check_out).
